description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog for inserting or editing a 'hiddenfield' input element, with functionalities for initializing dialog contents and handling user input to set attributes on the input element.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Initializes the dialog with the currently selected element if it is a checkbox input, or prepares for inserting a new hidden input.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the creation or updating of the hidden input element based on user input, inserting it into the editor content if necessary.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Defines the dialog configuration including title, size, contents, and behavior for show and OK actions.
